item.title: Jamaat pledges to act as custodian of public trust
item.description: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr Shafiqur Rahman on Sunday said his party does not seek to plunder public money or siphon it abroad, pledging instead to act as a custodian of people’s trust if voted into power.He made the remarks while addressing voters of the Dhaka-7 constituency as the chief guest of an election rally in Alia Madrasa ground on January 25. item.title: 3 killed, hundreds of thousands without power as major winter storm hits US

item.description: Students of Jagannath University's (JnU) 20th batch of the 2024–25 academic year have been observing sit-in, locking the administration building demanding special scholarship.Since night, Vice-Chancellor Prof. Md. item.title: Natalie Portman criticizes Oscars 2026 for overlooking women filmmakers
item.description: Hollywood actress Natalie Portman has criticized the Oscars 2026 for not properly recognizing women filmmakers. She raised the issue during a press conference at the Sundance Film Festival for her new film The Gallerist.Portman said several strong films by women directors were ignored this year. While Hamnet, directed by Chloe Zhao, received eight nominations, broader representation of women in awards was missing.
